question: A side of a square plot is 150 m. Inside the plot, 3.5 m wide path is constructed all around the side, the area of the path is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of path inside a square = 4 × width × (side − width)

Given: side = 150 m, width = 3.5 m

Area = 4 × 3.5 × (150 − 3.5)

Area = 14 × 146.5 = 2051 sq. m.

**∴ The correct answer is 2051 sq. m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Side of square plot = 150 m, Width of path = 3.5 m

Formula: Area of path = Area of outer square − Area of inner square

 
 
 Outer Side = 150 m
 Inner Side = 143 m
 
• 
 3.5 m
 Shaded Path Area

⇒ Side of outer square (a) = 150 m

⇒ Side of inner square = 150 − (2 × 3.5) = 150 − 7 = 143 m

⇒ Area of outer square = 150 × 150 = 22500 sq. m

⇒ Area of inner square = 143 × 143 = 20449 sq. m

⇒ Area of path = 22500 − 20449 = 2051 sq. m

**∴ The correct answer is 2051 sq. m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Outer Path

When a path of width w is constructed outside a square of side a, the area of path = 4w(a + w).

Area of Middle Cross-roads

If two paths of width w cross each other at right angles in the center of a square, the area = w(2a − w).

Square Perimeter and Area

Area = side² and Perimeter = 4 × side.</p
